title: Implement the initial ProgressTrace benchmark runner and baseline detectors
objective: Implement the smallest benchmark component required by the original ProgressTrace MVP plan: approximately 20 explicit, synthetic or locally controlled trace cases; deterministic max-turns, exact-repeat, and fuzzy-repeat/cycle baselines; and a reproducible runner that executes the existing ProgressTrace evaluator and those baselines over the same cases and emits stable machine-readable results. Preserve the existing Phase 0–2b contracts and normative Core semantics. Do not build a production adapter, report UI, or expand the product scope.
deliverables: Benchmark project referencing the existing Core only
Approximately 20 explicitly labeled benchmark cases, with no sensitive data
Deterministic max-turns, exact-repeat, and fuzzy-repeat/cycle baseline implementations
non_goals: No OpenTelemetry or Hermes production adapter
No stable adapter schema or plugin framework
No 60-trace corpus, dual-human oracle, or Cohen kappa
No UI, web API, database, hosted service, GitHub Action, or online interruption
No LLM judge or model calls
No changes to existing contracts or Core semantics
stop_conditions: A baseline definition is semantically ambiguous and requires a new normative contract
The benchmark requires changes to protected Core/contracts paths
Results are not deterministic on immediate rerun
Sensitive or external production data would be required
The implementation exceeds the allowed paths or attempts scope expansion
Two bounded repair attempts are exhausted
